intended_application: Draft replies to routine customer-support messages from an approved knowledge base; a human agent reviews and sends each reply
organization: Northstar Components, a fictional manufacturer with an internal warranty desk
business_need: Improve response quality and handling time without removing human approval
users_stakeholders: Support agents, product customers, quality reviewers
capabilities_constraints: Current agents search a knowledge base and draft replies manually. In this constructed scenario, the desk is a cost center and the firm's core revenue comes from product sales; no pilot, pricing, or productivity outcome has been observed.
risk_consequence_context: Incorrect answers could harm customers; human approval and escalation are required
management_question: Classify the proposed use and its possible significance over the next 12 months
additional_context: Constructed teaching case. The LLM is the same existing external service and the intended application is identical to the primary case. The business model is a scenario assumption, not a verified real-company fact.
